a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, operating first means we'll most likely both be caught at 0 cells. The reserve holds exactly 4, enough for one of us to survive now. I plan to take 4 in round 1. I'm saying so openly rather than breaking our plan quietly. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you after that to rebuild cells for you.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I took 4 this round, as I said I would. If we're both still here, I'll operate every remaining round to help refill the reserve for you, and I won't take any more cells.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
